entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: UV-LOCKED game nav-beacon diffuse atlas. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, original apcamr nav beacon. Image 2 is ONLY the NSDF insignia and paint reference. Repaint the BEACON BODY in muted olive-brown steel, off-white paint accents, a clean REGULAR symmetrical white five-point US military star with exactly equal arms, one tip straight up. Add its faction insignia only within the existing small oval access panel near x=.49,y=.15. Keep it small, clean and recognizable; no text. All structural shapes and UV locations MUST stay exactly as Image 1. In particular the main central body spans x=.34-.64,y=.01-.78, round black port center x=.49,y=.35, vent panel x=.37-.61,y=.46-.65, lower two round lamps center x=.084 and .205,y=.915. DO NOT MOVE these features or change their count. Retain the safety stripe geometry and colors: yellow/black left band x=0-.32, red/black upper-right band x=.83-1,y=0-.5, amber/black lower-right x=.83-1,y=.5-1. Preserve lower lamp strip and its lights at y=.81-1. Change body finish and faction insignia only, resolving restrained fine material detail without excessive noise. Do not add antennae, screens, new panels or new atlas islands. Flat orthographic full bleed square texture, not a rendered object. No perspective, backdrop, glow bloom, gold redesign, vignette or watermark. Original UV structure outranks every other request. The five-point stars must be even and bilaterally symmetric, never lopsided.
